name: Gear Courier
story: Tock's clockwork post office has shutters facing two ways. Turn the gear parcels through front and side delivery slots, then send on the closing chime for a bonus.
objective: Deliver six gear parcels to restart the town clock.
twist: Front and side shutters alternate. The first shutter in each direction arrives slowly; later shutters gather speed. Send in the final second for a beat bonus.
rule: Fit the parcel through alternating front and side gates. Six deliveries win; three bonks close the post office.
controls: E/Q: turn in 3D · Arrows/WASD: align on current wall · Space: send · Final-second sends earn a beat bonus
opening_hint: E/Q turns the parcel; arrows align its outline with the gap. Space sends it through.
fail_text: The gates have closed. Try this route again!
